claim: OD-TBD filed 2026-10-08 from fix/orders-send-blank-followups (PR #672 gate, owed item 6; ADR 0255 addendum of 2026-10-08): requestDraftSend and processScheduledAutoSends each compare the vendor's providers.restaurant_id with the house before they use that vendor (the first name that fills the greeting, and in the sweep also the address it mails).
